name: ControlButton
description: Icon-only media-overlay control (play/pause, next, close). v2 architecture: a single `media` style whose scrim background reads on any surface — the v1 Context and background axes were removed; page theming flows from variable modes, not props.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name — rendered as aria-label; the button is icon-only

props.name: forceState
props.description: Docs-only state pinning via data-force-state (mirrors Button convention)

knownTokenGaps: --s2a-color-control-button-* component tokens are bound in Figma (collection S2A/Semantic/Color/Theme) but not yet emitted by the shipped tokens release — CSS chains each to the shipped primitive it resolves to today. Remove the fallback chains when they ship.
Sizes (32/48) and the 16px icon rig use spacing tokens of identical value (--s2a-spacing-xl/-3xl/-md); Figma binds no dimension variables on the variant frames themselves.

notes: Icon-only control: `label` is mandatory in practice — it becomes aria-label (WCAG 1.1.1 / 4.1.2).
Focus state renders a 1px focus-ring/default outline at the button bounds, matching the v2 Figma Focus Ring layer (2.4.7).
md size is 32×32 — meets WCAG 2.5.8 minimum target size (24px); xl comfortably exceeds it.
Figma's focus variant stroke alignment was assumed outline-at-bounds (outline-offset: 0).
